params.hires.title: High-resolution fix
params.hires.info: Draws the picture, enlarges it and draws it again with the same seed and settings, so the larger picture gets real detail. It takes about twice as long.
params.hires.scaleInfo: How much larger than the first picture. The final size is rounded to multiples of 8.
params.hires.strengthInfo: Low keeps the first picture almost as it is; high redraws more of it. Too high can break shapes.
params.hires.methodInfo: Smooth: enlarges without a model. An upscale model: enlarges with an installed model, then resizes to the size (usually sharper).
params.hires.stepsInfo: 0 uses as many steps as the first pass.
params.hires.outputSameSteps: Result: {width}×{height} (second pass with the same steps)
params.readiness.hiresNoModel: The upscale model of the high-resolution fix is not installed
params.readiness.hiresLarge: {width}×{height} may be too large for a {base} model (about {max} px on the long side is comfortable). Lower the scale if the picture breaks up.

params.profile.mismatch.stepsLow: Too few steps (recommended {value}, at least {min}). With too few, the picture can break up or come out as one flat color
params.profile.mismatch.stepsHigh: More steps than the recommended {value} (above {max}). It takes longer and the picture changes little
params.scheduler.detail.euler: Plain and fast. A safe default.
params.scheduler.detail.euler_a: Re-adds noise every step. Varied results; the picture changes with the step count.
params.scheduler.detail.euler_k: Euler with Karras spacing. Cleaner detail in fewer steps.
params.scheduler.detail.dpmpp_2m: A standard that settles reliably in few steps.
params.scheduler.detail.dpmpp_2m_k: DPM++ 2M with Karras spacing. Crisp detail; the most used.
params.scheduler.detail.dpmpp_2m_sde_k: Adds randomness for richer texture. Slightly slower and less repeatable.
params.scheduler.detail.dpmpp_sde_k: High quality, but about twice as slow: two evaluations per step.
params.scheduler.detail.heun: Accurate and smooth, but slow: two evaluations per step.
params.scheduler.detail.lms: An older method with a soft finish.
params.scheduler.detail.ddim: Gentle and repeatable. Suits generating from an image.
params.scheduler.detail.unipc: Converges fast, even around 10 steps. For quick results.
params.scheduler.detail.lcm: Only for LCM models or LoRAs. Use 4-8 steps and CFG 1-2.
params.scheduler.detail.tcd: Only for TCD LoRAs. Draws in few steps.
